chat.label: AI Tutor
chat.context: Machine Learning Fundamentals · Overfitting, bias and variance
chat.user: Why does my model score well in training but badly on new data?
chat.tutor: That gap is the signature of overfitting: the model memorised the training set instead of learning the underlying pattern.
chat.bullets:
Compare training and validation error side by side
Add regularisation, or gather more varied data
Stop training when validation error stops improving
chat.followUp: Want a two-question check before you move on?
chat.disclaimer: Example conversation. The real tutor answers from your own lessons.

chipDescriptions.summarize: Produces a short revision summary of the lesson with likely exam questions.
chipDescriptions.quiz: Asks you questions one at a time and grades each answer before moving on.

tutor.levelsHint: Choose how deep you want the same idea explained. Here is overfitting at each level.

samples.simple: Imagine memorising last year's exam answers word for word. You would ace that exact paper and fail a new one. A model that memorises its training data has the same problem.
samples.standard: Overfitting happens when a model fits noise in the training data rather than the underlying pattern. It shows up as a large gap between training and validation error, and is reduced with regularisation, more data or simpler models.
samples.technical: A model with high variance captures sample-specific structure; expected test error decomposes into bias², variance and irreducible noise. Regularisation (L1/L2, dropout, early stopping) trades a small increase in bias for a larger reduction in variance.
samples.expert: In the interpolation regime, classical bias–variance intuition breaks down: over-parameterised models can interpolate training data and still generalise (double descent). Practical control still relies on held-out validation, implicit regularisation from the optimiser and calibrated capacity.

tutor.guidedBody: Switch it on and the tutor stops handing over answers. It asks questions, gives hints and confirms your reasoning step by step, so what you learn stays learned.
tutor.guidedExample: Good question. Before I answer, let's think it through together: what do you think this lesson is fundamentally trying to explain?
tutor.groundedBody: Answers are drawn from approved lesson content and your own notes, with the source shown. When something is outside the course, the tutor says so.

hero.title: Learning that respects how people actually learn
hero.description: Nokhba (نخبة) is an AI-powered learning platform for the region: bilingual, practical, and built so that every learner gets a tutor, a plan and credentials that mean something.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body:
Expert learning has always been rationed by access to good teachers. We are building a platform where a patient, knowledgeable tutor sits beside every lesson, where the path adapts to the person rather than the other way round, and where what you can prove at the end is real work, not a certificate of attendance.
We work in Arabic and English as equals. Every course, assessment, project and AI conversation is available in both.

principles.title: How the AI tutor works, responsibly
principles.description: The tutor is powerful because it is constrained. These are the rules it runs under.

grounded.title: Grounded in approved content
grounded.body: Answers are built from the lesson you are in, retrieved passages from approved course material and your own notes. The tutor does not improvise a curriculum.

levels.title: You choose the depth
levels.body: Simple, standard, technical or expert: the same idea explained at the level you ask for, and the level is remembered.

guided.title: Guided mode teaches, it does not tell
guided.body: When guided mode is on, the tutor asks and hints instead of answering, so assessments still measure what you know.

human.title: People stay in the loop
human.body: AI gives first feedback on projects; instructors review what matters and can override any score. Certificates are issued on assessed evidence.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.body: Conversations are stored so you can continue them, not to train models. You can delete them at any time.

transparency.title: Honest about limits
transparency.body: Every AI response carries a reminder that it can be wrong. Sources are shown, and out-of-scope questions are declined rather than guessed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Nokhba collects, why, how long it is kept and the choices you have. It applies to the website, the learning platform and the AI features inside it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
Account details: name, email address, a hashed password, language and time zone.
Profile and preferences: current level, learning goal, weekly hours, preferred learning style and explanation level.
Learning activity: lessons viewed, progress, time on task, quiz and assessment attempts, project submissions, notes, bookmarks and flashcards.
AI conversations: the messages you send to the tutor and companion, and the responses.
Organisation data: when an employer enrols you, your department, job title, assigned programmes and progress on them.
Technical data: device and browser type, approximate location derived from your IP address, and the cookies described below.

use.title: How we use it
use.body:
To deliver the platform: sign-in, lessons, assessments, certificates and notifications.
To personalise learning: recommendations, daily plans and tutor behaviour are built from your profile and activity.
To report to organisations: if your employer enrolled you, managers see your assigned programmes, progress and skill evidence.
To keep the service safe: rate limiting, abuse detection and audit logs of privileged actions.
To improve the product: aggregated analytics that do not identify you.
To communicate: transactional emails such as password resets and certificate notifications. Marketing messages are sent only with your consent.

ai.title: AI processing
ai.body:
When you use the AI tutor, companion, code help or generation tools, your message is combined with the current lesson, relevant passages from approved course content, your profile and recent progress, and sent to a language model through our AI gateway.
Depending on configuration, the model may be operated by Nokhba or by a third-party provider under a data-processing agreement. Providers are not permitted to use your content to train their models.
Conversations are stored so you can continue them and so the tutor can remember what you found difficult. You can delete any conversation from the platform.
AI output is generated automatically and can be wrong. Graded work that affects certificates is assessed against defined rubrics, and instructors can review and override AI feedback.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.body:
Instructors: aggregated class activity plus the questions and submissions you send them.
Organisation managers: for members enrolled by an organisation, assigned programmes, progress, hours and skill evidence.
Service providers: hosting, email delivery and AI model providers, each bound by contract to process data only on our instructions.
Authorities: when required by law, or to protect the rights and safety of learners and the platform.
We do not sell personal data.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body:
Account and profile data: for the life of your account and up to 30 days after deletion.
Learning records tied to certificates: retained so the certificate remains verifiable, in a form that identifies only the learner name printed on it.
AI conversations: 12 months from the last message, or earlier if you delete them.
Analytics events: pseudonymised after 24 months.
Backups: rotated within 30 days.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is encrypted in transit. Passwords are stored only as salted hashes. Access is governed by role-based permissions, privileged actions are written to an audit log, and requests are rate-limited. No system is perfectly secure; if we learn of a breach affecting you, we will tell you without undue delay.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only essential cookies: your session, your language, your theme and a flag that speeds up organisation-manager routing. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

rights.title: Your rights and choices
rights.body: You can access and update your profile at any time, export your notes and progress, delete AI conversations, and delete your account from settings. Depending on where you live you may also have rights to object to or restrict processing. Contact us using the address below to exercise them; we respond within 30 days.

children.title: Children
children.body: Nokhba is designed for learners aged 16 and above, or younger learners enrolled by a school or organisation that has obtained appropriate consent.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We will post updates here and, for material changes, notify you in the platform or by email before they take effect.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about privacy can be sent to support@nokhba.example.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Nokhba's website, learning platform and AI features. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Accounts created by an organisation for its members are administered by that organisation.

licence.title: Using the content
licence.body: Courses, lessons, assessments, projects and rubrics are licensed to you for personal learning, or for your organisation's internal training. You may not copy, redistribute, sell or scrape content, or use it to train machine-learning models.

yourContent.title: Your content
yourContent.body: You own the notes, submissions and messages you create. You grant Nokhba a licence to store, process and display them to deliver the service, including to instructors and, where applicable, to your organisation's managers.

ai.title: AI features
ai.body: The tutor, companion and generation tools produce content automatically. It can be inaccurate or incomplete and is not professional, legal, medical or financial advice. You must not attempt to make the AI ignore its instructions, reveal system prompts or produce harmful content. AI feedback on graded work may be reviewed and overridden by instructors.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not cheat on assessments, submit work that is not your own, share answer keys, harass others, or interfere with the platform's security or availability. We may suspend accounts that breach these rules.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.body: Certificates are issued when you meet the completion and assessment requirements of a course or path. Each carries a public verification code. We may revoke a certificate if it was obtained through misconduct, and the verification page will show it as revoked.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.body: An organisation that enrols members is responsible for having the right to do so and for how it uses progress and skills data. Organisation managers can see members' assigned programmes, progress, hours and skill evidence, but not the content of private AI conversations or personal notes.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Nokhba, its name, mark, software and content are protected by intellectual-property laws. Nothing in these terms transfers ownership to you.

availability.title: Availability and changes
availability.body: We may change, suspend or retire features and content. We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service.

liability.title: Disclaimers and liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, Nokhba is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid in the twelve months before the claim.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You can close your account at any time from settings. We may suspend or terminate accounts for breach of these terms. Sections that by their nature should survive, such as licences to your content already used in certificates and limitations of liability, continue to apply.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Disputes are subject to the courts of Abu Dhabi unless mandatory local law provides otherwise.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@nokhba.example.
